title.value: Dynamics of SGD with Stochastic Polyak Stepsizes: Truly Adaptive Variants and Convergence to Exact Solution
title.justification: The paper primarily investigates the dynamics and convergence of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) using stochastic Polyak stepsizes and introduces new variants of this technique.
title.quote: Dynamics of SGD with Stochastic Polyak Stepsizes: Truly Adaptive Variants and Convergence to Exact Solution

extractions.description: The paper studies the dynamics of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) with stochastic Polyak stepsizes, proposing novel variants that address limitations in non-over-parameterized regimes such as convergence only to a neighborhood of the solution. It introduces DecSPS, a new method that guarantees convergence to the exact minimizer and discusses practical applications and convergence guarantees for these new approaches in convex optimization problems.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is primarily focused on mathematical and optimization techniques in machine learning rather than directly addressing issues related to climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: We study the dynamics and the convergence properties of SGD equipped with new variants of the stochastic Polyak stepsize and provide solutions to both drawbacks of the original SPS.
